description: This file defines the LibraryDiscoveryCollector class, which extends CacheCollector and implements LibraryDiscoveryInterface. It manages library definitions, overrides, and extensions within Drupal, utilizing cache, theme, and parser components.

classes.name: LibraryDiscoveryCollector
classes.description: A cache-based implementation for collecting and managing library extension information in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collector with cache, lock, parser, and theme manager dependencies.

methods.name: getCid
methods.description: Generates a cache ID based on the active theme name.

methods.name: resolveCacheMiss
methods.description: Loads library definitions for a given key when cache is missing.

methods.name: getLibraryDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves and processes library definitions for a specific extension, applying overrides and extensions.

methods.name: applyLibrariesExtend
methods.description: Extends a library definition with additional libraries specified by the active theme.

methods.name: getLibrariesByExtension
methods.description: Returns libraries for a specific extension.

methods.name: getLibraryByName
methods.description: Returns a specific library by extension and name, with deprecation warning if applicable.

methods.name: clearCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Deprecated method to clear cache, replaced by 'clear'.
